synthesizedFacts.fact: Fine lines on cheeks when smiling are often caused by dynamic muscle contractions that fold the skin, and over time, these can become static wrinkles due to decreased collagen and elastin.
Sun exposure, dehydration, and repetitive facial expressions are significant contributors to the formation of fine lines and wrinkles.
Treatments for fine lines include sun protection, moisturization, collagen stimulation, and the use of facial fillers.
Genetics and bone structure can influence the appearance and depth of smile lines.
